releaseNotes: Regenerating this week now picks different suitable meals and respects the household budget.
Shopping is split into cupboard checking and online basket checking, with one clear list and category filters.
Checked quantities are retained when recipes change, including partial quantities still needed.
The checklist stays editable after Order placed; only items actually added to the basket are recorded as purchases.
New cupboards start empty. Historical suggested stock stays protected until its quantities are confirmed.
Stock is only added after a confirmed delivery, and incompatible quantities cannot overwrite existing inventory.
Landscape tablet quantity controls and navigation feedback are improved.
